entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: We can start during the day,[n]since you're a student.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: We can't do it when it rains[n]though, since we'll be outside...
entries.uk: Але в дощ не вийде,[n]бо ми будемо надворі...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Come during the day[n]for your fortune[n]and at night for the test.
entries.uk: Приходь удень по ворожіння,[n]а ввечері — на випробування.
